design.quote: This pre-specified analysis of DICTATE-AHF evaluated 238 patients randomized within 24 hours of AHF hospital admission to dapagliflozin 10 mg daily or structured usual care

population.value: Patients with acute heart failure (AHF) hospitalized within 24 hours of admission
population.quote: 238 patients randomized within 24 hours of AHF hospital admission

sample_size.quote: 238 patients randomized within 24 hours of AHF hospital admission

comparator.value: Structured usual care with protocolized IV diuretics
comparator.quote: structured usual care, with protocolized IV diuretics in both groups

primary_findings.quote: eGFR at randomization did not modify dapagliflozin's treatment effect on diuretic efficiency assessed by weight loss (interaction p = 0.22), diuresis (interaction p = 0.23), or natriuresis (interaction p = 0.36).
primary_findings.outcome: Interaction of eGFR with dapagliflozin effect on weight loss, diuresis, and natriuresis

primary_findings.quote: Dapagliflozin was not associated with a decrease in eGFR (p = 0.89), blood urea nitrogen (BUN) (p = 0.94), nor BUN/serum creatinine ratio (p = 0.41) from randomization to end-of-study.
primary_findings.outcome: Change in eGFR, BUN, and BUN/serum creatinine ratio from randomization to end-of-study
